newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine anti-crime journalist shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Philippine anti-crime journalist shot dead.

text.p: The news editor of the Philippines' most popular tabloid, who specialised in exposing crime syndicates, was found shot dead in a taxi on Tuesday morning, police said.
Danny Hernandez, with the daily People's Journal Tonight, had been shot in the back of the neck in a Manila suburb.
Police said the taxi had been comandeered late on Monday night but had no other details.
Interior Secretary Robert Barbers said he would order a thorough investigation of the murder.
At the time of his death, Hernandez had been writing stories exposing illegal drug and gambling syndicates.
More than 50 journalists have been killed in the Philippines over the past 20 years, most of them during the dictatorship of late president Ferdinand Marcos.
Last December, a veteran broadcasting editor, also known for exposing criminal activities, was shot dead. Two people are facing trial for the killing.
